scientific.first_public_date_evidence: A public technical discussion dated 2017-12-19 links OpenReview ryQu7f-RZ and explicitly names AMSGrad; this is the earliest exact-dated public-availability evidence located, earlier than the later arXiv mirror.
scientific.integrity: The full AMSGrad state is linearized on the open inactive-maximum branch. The proof keeps the neutral retained-memory direction explicit, separates the current second-moment mode, and applies exact Jury conditions to the position-momentum block.
limitations: Scalar deterministic quadratic and constant step size.
Local analysis on a fixed inactive maximum-memory branch.
The retained maximum is treated as an optimizer state; the theorem does not predict which memory value a given standard-initialized trajectory selects.
Practical epsilon-regularized variants have shifted thresholds.

title: Exact history-selected transverse spectrum of AMSGrad
